title: Qualify portable host concurrency
requires: Host thread runtime; one advertised native driver
scope: Add public-API concurrency cases for physical-device queries, distinct command pools and independent mutable objects without executing undefined same-object races.
acceptance: Repeated concurrent physical-device queries and independent-pool recording pass through the loader and validation layer.
Evidence names each driver profile and keeps externally synchronized same-object access outside executable negative controls.
evidence: PASS Windows D3D12 validation profile NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080: 20/20 repeated runs; eight threads each completed 256 query snapshots and 256 independent-pool record/reset cycles with zero diagnostics.
PASS Windows VS18 D3D12 command API plus host concurrency 2/2 and loader/layer regression slice 13/13.
PASS public fixture compilation with MSVC 14.51 headless SDK and GCC 13.3 WSL SDK; generated references and 19 roadmap unit tests passed.
